concerns.text: Success criterion SC‑004 (total pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h) has no associated task that records or asserts the overall execution time, leaving the criterion untestable.

Success criterion SC‑005 (memory usage ≤ 4 GB) is only mitigated by conditional batch‑size reduction; there is no explicit task that measures, logs, and verifies that the memory ceiling is respected throughout the workflow.
